selection_forbidden_inputs: row byte offset or row length

smoke_rule.algorithm: Within each benchmark, rank public instance IDs by row_score with split grader-smoke and greedily take the first two repository-distinct rows. Preserve benchmark order and rank order. Expand each selected public identity to GOLD then NOOP only after selection.

development_rule.algorithm: In benchmark order, rank every eligible public instance ID by row_score and greedily take the first row from each previously unseen repository until the per-benchmark count is reached. Exclude identities already selected by an earlier benchmark in this split. Preserve benchmark order and rank order.

heldout_rule.swebench_verified_algorithm: Rank every eligible public instance ID by row_score and greedily take the first row from each previously unseen repository until 12 rows are reached.
heldout_rule.multi_language_order: Rank every normalized language by sha256(seed|trimem-selector-v3|heldout|benchmark_id|language|normalized_language), then language ascending as tie-breaker; take the first exact count.
heldout_rule.multi_row_algorithm: Exclude identities already selected by an earlier benchmark in this split. Within each selected normalized language, take its lowest public-identity row_score whose repository is new within that benchmark when such a row exists; otherwise take the language rank-0 row. Preserve ranked language order.
